definitions.explanation: A woman who reigns as monarch herself, as opposed to the wife of an emperor. Figuratively, a woman who holds great power in some field.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦かつて→かつて：10303_katsute⟧⟦{何人|なんにん}→何人：17593_nannin⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{女帝|じょてい}がいた。
examples.english: Japan once had several reigning empresses.

examples.japanese: {推古天皇|すいこてんのう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{女帝|じょてい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Empress Suiko is considered Japan's first reigning empress.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦{業界|ぎょうかい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支配|しはい}→支配：01421_shihai⟧し、「{女帝|じょてい}」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれている→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: Having dominated the industry for years, she is called its "empress."

notes:
In Japanese history the word usually refers to the eight women who reigned as ⟦{天皇|てんのう}→天皇：04546_tennou⟧, the last of them in the eighteenth century.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{皇后|こうごう}→皇后：16354_kougou⟧: empress consort, the wife of an emperor
- ⟦{女王|じょおう}→女王：03349_joou⟧: queen

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{政界|せいかい}→政界：15196_seikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{女帝|じょてい}: the empress of the political world (a powerful woman politician)
